description: This file contains the implementation of the ApkCheck class, which performs dependency and API compliance checks on Android APK files by comparing their contents against a published API specification defined in XML format. It includes logic for parsing XML API descriptions, flattening class hierarchies, and reporting violations such as illegal references, missing classes, fields, and methods.

classes.name: ApkCheck
classes.description: Main class responsible for checking APK dependencies against the API specification, parsing XML files, and reporting issues.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point; processes command-line arguments, loads API descriptions, and runs dependency checks on APK files.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints usage instructions and command-line options.

methods.name: parseApiDescr
methods.description: Loads an API description XML file into an ApiList instance.

methods.name: parseXml
methods.description: Parses an XML file using SAX parser to populate an ApiList with API data.

methods.name: flattenInherited
methods.description: Expands class hierarchies in ApiList to include inherited methods and fields for comprehensive API checks.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Compares an APK's API content against the public API to detect violations.

methods.name: isIgnorable
methods.description: Determines if a package should be ignored based on the ignore list.

methods.name: apkWarning
methods.description: Outputs a warning message related to the APK being checked.

methods.name: apkError
methods.description: Outputs an error message related to the APK being checked.

methods.name: dumpApi
methods.description: Recursively outputs the contents of an ApiList for debugging purposes.

methods.name: dumpPackage
methods.description: Outputs the details of a package within an ApiList.

methods.name: dumpClass
methods.description: Outputs the details of a class within the API.
